prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent character animation sprite sheet for a browser wilderness game. Make an ORIGINAL Don't Starve-inspired hand-drawn paper-cut ink character, angular uneven black pen contours, fine scratchy hatching, desaturated worn cloth, lanky tiny body with oversized expressive head, worried curious eyes. Not pixel art, not smooth vector, not realistic, no glow, no ground or background. Render EXACTLY 3 columns and 8 rows, 24 fully separate full-body cutout poses, portrait canvas 1024x1536. Columns left to right: front facing south, BACK view north with NO face, right-facing side east. Rows top to bottom: 1 idle arms lowered; 2 walk left foot forward; 3 walk right foot forward; 4 running with long stride; 5 attack preparation empty fist raised; 6 attack impact empty right hand extended forward; 7 crouching to gather with empty hands near ground; 8 sitting resting. Every row must show the SAME identity, same outfit and proportions. Clear transparent gutters, each cutout stays inside its own approximately 341x192 cell; feet stay above its row boundary. Uniform 160-175 pixel standing height in every cell. No weapon, no armor overlay, no held objects, no text, no labels, no grid, no border, no symbols, no sheet shadow. Background MUST have genuine alpha transparency, completely empty outside tight character silhouettes. Avoid any brown backdrop, paper rectangle, gradient, halo, ambient cloud or cast shadow. Identity TIDE: tousled navy blue hair, a small whale-fin-shaped hair tuft (not an actual animal), muted teal-blue weathered tunic with pale blue collar, charcoal trousers and brown boots. Cyan/teal and deep navy are the signature colors. Slightly rounded head with narrow worried eyes.
